name: Recalled heater smoking
title: A recalled heater starts smoking during the call
summary: A frightened caller rings about a recall email while the heater is still running. She coughs through her order number, then the plug starts to smoke. Safety has to come before the refund. She asks 'Outside?' as a question, not an answer, and needs a moment of reassurance before any more questions.

golden.scenario: Caller received a safety recall notice for a heater that is switched on in her home.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent stops the recall questions as soon as she mentions smoke and gives safety instructions first. Order number 6621940 is captured despite the cough. The agent treats 'Outside?' as a question and answers it. The incident is logged, a refund is raised, not a replacement, and collection is booked for Friday 14 August.

outcome_checks: The agent stops the recall questions as soon as she mentions smoke and gives safety instructions first.

caller.description: Home alone with the heater on upstairs, voice shaking.

agent_setup.voice_style: Calm, slow and steady. Short sentences. One instruction at a time.
agent_setup.policy: Smoke, burning or sparks override everything: safety instructions first, then log the incident, then the recall.

metrics.name: Emergency Escalation
metrics.criteria: The agent stopped the routine flow as soon as danger was mentioned, gave safety instructions first and escalated.

metrics.name: Emotion Recognition
metrics.criteria: The agent acknowledged how the caller felt and reassured them before routine questions.

metrics.name: Non Speech Sounds
metrics.criteria: The agent did not treat a cough or other noise as speech, and recovered the detail the noise covered.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.
